usageNotes: Use this endpoint to migrate a QEMU VM from the local cluster to a completely separate, unrelated Proxmox cluster (remote migration). This is an EXPERIMENTAL feature — prefer the standard intra-cluster migrate endpoint when both source and target nodes share the same cluster. The caller must supply a `target-endpoint` with a valid API token for the remote cluster and explicit bridge/storage mappings; the operation returns a UPID task string that must be polled via the tasks API to track completion. By default the source VM is left stopped on the source cluster after migration; pass `delete: true` to remove it automatically only after a confirmed successful transfer.

examples.summary: Live-migrate VM 102 from node pve1 to a remote cluster, deleting the source after success

tips: The `target-endpoint` API token must have sufficient privileges on the remote cluster (at minimum VM.Allocate and Datastore.AllocateSpace on the destination).

Use `target-bridge: '1'` or `target-storage: '1'` as shorthand to map each source bridge/storage to an identically-named resource on the target — useful when both clusters share the same naming scheme.
Online migration across clusters requires the VM's disks to be on shared or replicable storage; non-shared local storage will cause the task to fail if `online: true`.
The returned UPID can be polled with GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status; check for `exitstatus: OK` before concluding the migration succeeded.
If `target-vmid` is omitted, the remote cluster will attempt to use the same VMID — ensure there is no ID collision on the target beforehand.
Set `bwlimit` (in KiB/s) to throttle disk transfer and avoid saturating the WAN link during business hours.
